Messages.Author: Michael Bradley
Messages.Body:
Do vampires count as uncommons in boosters?
I thought they could, and also that some vamps
are even rare.
Say it ain't so!
I like having plentiful numbers of vamps of established
clans. I don't mind promo one-offs like Dan.
The plentiful number of allies and retainers is
good, but I don't think that the 11 caps
should be as rare as some of the best allies.

-Michael

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


The 11-capacity independent vampires in Final Nights are rare.
The rest are uncommon.
